title: Batch 1 production candidate: essential checks passed
summary: 39 focused tests, TypeScript, focused lint, standard Node 24 production build and 24 local browser checks passed. Exact four-file source delta verified; no deployment yet.

changes.detail: Verified truthful delivery pricing, failed-quote feedback/retry, address/cart invalidation, stale responses and COD/PayPal recovery while preserving real order errors and idempotency.

validation.name: Focused security and checkout
validation.detail: 39/39. Initial Git safe-directory failure corrected with process-local configuration; no global Git settings changed.

validation.name: Types, lint and production build
validation.detail: Node 24 standard npm run build including normal prebuild passed. Initial font download failed in network sandbox; unchanged source passed with permitted network access. Existing lint warnings remain.

validation.name: Browser regression
validation.detail: 24 checks at 320/390/768/1440 widths; all API and external requests mocked/blocked locally. No real customer or payment side effects.

validation.name: Source scope
validation.detail: 2,053 live baseline source files preserved except three modified files and one added feedback component. No staging runtime/config/credentials or migrations. SEO and server payment/order/auth code unchanged.

validation.name: Production deployment and physical devices
validation.detail: Not deployed at report time. No real transaction, screen-reader or physical-device verification.
